title: DocBlock
text: Create text that documents model and save text with model, {Document type} sets Type of document; {Code generation template symbol} sets the template symbol for generated code. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Code generation template symbol
params.values: Template symbol for generated code ’’ | Abstract | Description | History | Modified History | Notes

params.name: Document type
params.values: Type of document Text (default) | RTF | HTML
